biggest_catch: The $50 credit only lands within 60 days of the referred friend's plan start date, and either side cancelling their plan or falling into arrears before then forfeits the bonus entirely.
catches: Both $50 bonuses are bill credits applied within 60 days of the referred customer's plan start date — not instant at signup.
If you or your referred friend cancels the Energy Plan, or either account goes into arrears before the bonus is applied, neither side receives the bonus.
Referred friend must sign up using your unique ENMAX referral link and must not have been an Easymax customer in the last 12 months.
Referred customer is eligible for a maximum of one referral bonus; referrer capped at 15 bonuses per calendar year (up to $750 in credits).
Bonuses cannot be transferred, exchanged for cash, or combined with other programs; ENMAX may suspend or terminate the program at any time.
Savings framing: the bonus reduces a future energy bill in Alberta (CAD amounts), not cash income; you must already be an Easymax customer to earn the referrer-side credit.

steps: Log in to your ENMAX online account for your existing Easymax Energy Plan.
Find your unique referral link in your account.
Send the referral link to a friend or family member (complying with anti-spam rules; no paid advertising of the link).
Friend signs up for an Easymax Energy Plan using your referral link and meets plan eligibility criteria.
$50 bill credits are applied to both your account and your friend's account within 60 days of the friend's plan start date.
